notes: This is a Mo Willems 'Pigeon' book. The Pigeon character is highly distinctive and will not be found in standard Boardmaker libraries — sourcing a clip art PNG is essential for student recognition. The book centres on bedtime resistance, so vocabulary around tiredness, nighttime, and staying awake is most functional. 'Bus driver' is included as the secondary named human character who interacts with Pigeon in this series. If the exact title cannot be confirmed as a Mo Willems book, verify authorship before finalising — the slug and theme are consistent with the Pigeon series.
